comments.headline: Critical site features lack graphic depiction
comments.summary: Key site infrastructure elements—dumpster location, light poles, and streetscape features—are not graphically depicted on the site and landscape plans, preventing verification of consistency across sheets.
comments.attn: Light pole and streetscape element matching could not be fully verified in run 1. Recommend explicit callout of all three elements on both sheets.

details.text: No dumpster or central trash enclosure location is shown on Site Plan (Sheet 9) or Landscape Plan (Sheet 31), though a Trash Collection Notes callout appears on Sheet 9.

runComments.comment: No dumpster or central trash enclosure location is shown on either the site plan (Sheet 9) or the landscape plan (Sheet 31). The site plan contains only a note stating that trash containers shall not be left at curbside unattended; there is no graphic depiction of a designated dumpster location for consistency checking between plan sheets.

Dumpster/trash enclosure location is not shown on the site plan or landscape plan. Trash Collection Notes appear on Sheet 9 but no actual dumpster location or trash enclosure is depicted graphically. This prevents verification of consistency between sheets and compliance with waste management requirements.

details.text: Light pole and streetlight fixture locations and quantities are not marked on the site plan or landscape plan. A lighting note and fixture types (Figure 34) appear on Sheet 9, but actual fixture locations and quantities are not depicted.

runComments.comment: Light pole and streetlight fixture locations and quantities are not called out on the landscape plan or other plan sheets. No light pole locations or fixture counts can be verified from the submitted materials.

Light pole and streetlight fixture locations are not marked or shown on the site plan or landscape plan. A lighting note and Figure 34 (fixture types) appear on Sheet 9, but actual fixture locations and quantities are not depicted, preventing verification of consistency between the landscape and site plans.

details.text: Streetscape elements including curb lines, parking layout, and parking garage entrance are shown but specific callouts cannot be verified as matching independently between landscape plan and site plan.

runComments.comment: Streetscape elements (curb lines, parking layout, parking stripes, parking garage entrance, light pole locations) are not confirmed as matching between the landscape plan and site plan. Both sheets show consistent site layout, but specific streetscape element callouts cannot be verified on both sheets independently.

comments.headline: Easement and property boundary documentation incomplete
comments.summary: Two perpetual recorded easements (Greenbelt Access & Use, City of Austin Drainage) and site measurements (property line bearings/distances) are not depicted on the site plan. Existing conditions survey, ESCP, and adjacent property depictions lack required callouts and boundaries.
comments.crossDep: Surveyor (boundary measurements and easement confirmation); Public Works / ROW (easement management and coordinate with recorded documents)
comments.attn: Verify all easement boundaries and site measurements with registered surveyor. Adjacent property representation could not be fully verified. Ensure Greenbelt and Drainage Easement boundaries are clearly shown and labeled on all affected sheets.

details.text: Two perpetual recorded easements are not shown on submitted site plan: Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731, 0.31 acres, NE interior of Lot 1) and City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137, 0.130 acres, NE corner of Lot 1), together encumbering ~0.44 acres (~19% of site).

runComments.comment: Two perpetual recorded easements are not depicted on the submitted site plan: (1) Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731, 0.31 acres, NE interior of Lot 1) and (2) City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137, 0.130 acres, NE corner of Lot 1). These easements together encumber approximately 0.44 acres (~19% of the site) and are required to be depicted before plan approval. The Existing Conditions Survey (Sheet 4) shows some easements labeled but does not show these two critical perpetual easements. All site plan and utility sheets must include depictions of these recorded easements.

Master Comment Report (LDE1) identifies that a License Agreement is required for the existing remaining concrete retaining wall adjacent to the street/ROW. The plans do not show callout with recorded document number or space for the license agreement reference, indicating this required legal instrument may not yet be executed and recorded with Travis County.

details.text: Perpetual easement areas (Greenbelt Access and City of Austin Drainage) are not labeled or depicted on Existing Conditions Survey (Sheet 4) or ESCP (Sheet 5), preventing verification of how proposed grading and drainage design interact with recorded easement constraints.

runComments.comment: While topography, existing structures, and drainage patterns are generally shown on the Existing Conditions Survey (Sheet 4) and ESCP (Sheet 5), the two perpetual easements (Greenbelt Access and City of Austin Drainage) that affect existing site conditions are not labeled or depicted on these sheets. These must be shown and labeled as existing recorded encumbrances affecting the permitted site boundary.

details.text: Site measurements including lot dimensions, bearings, and distances are not called out on the main site plan (Sheet 9), though the Plat (Sheet 2) shows boundary information. BCM 1.2.7 requires these measurements on the site plan.

runComments.comment: Site measurements (lot dimensions/perimeter distances) are not shown on the site plan. While site area (94,192 sq ft / 2.162 acres) is provided and legal description is referenced, specific property line dimensions, bearings, and distances required by BCM 1.2.7 are not called out on the plan sheets.

Site measurements (lot dimensions including bearings and distances) are not shown on the main site plan (Sheet 9). While the Plat (Sheet 2) shows boundary bearings and distances, these critical measurements are not visible on the site plan as required by BCM 1.2.7.

details.text: Adjacent properties (LOT 2 MECEY SUBDIVISION, LOT A CORTEZ HEIGHTS, others) are shown on plan sheets for context but cannot be confirmed as grayed out or distinguished with subdivision plot numbers.

runComments.comment: Adjacent properties (LOT 2 MECEY SUBDIVISION, LOT A CORTEZ HEIGHTS, and others) are shown on multiple plan sheets for context, but cannot be confirmed as grayed out or distinguishable with SP numbers. Representation of adjacent sites cannot be verified from available materials.

details.text: Drainage pattern delineation on the ESCP (Sheet 5) cannot be confirmed; no drainage pattern arrows, flow direction indicators, or boundaries are verified. Additionally, the relationship between proposed grading, drainage design, and easement constraints cannot be verified without easement boundaries being shown on the ESCP.

runComments.comment: Drainage pattern delineation is not confirmed on the ESCP plan sheets. ECM 1.4.4.B.3 requires ESCP sheets to include existing conditions and drainage pattern delineation; however, specific drainage pattern arrows, flow direction indicators, or drainage area boundaries cannot be verified from the ESCP materials provided.

Above-grade features affecting drainage patterns (buildings, retaining walls, utility infrastructure) are depicted on ESCP and site plan sheets; however, the depiction of how the two perpetual easement areas (Greenbelt and Drainage) relate to drainage infrastructure and grading cannot be fully verified without these easement boundaries being shown. The relationship between proposed grading, drainage design, and the easement constraints must be clearly demonstrated.

comments.headline: Recorded document numbers missing, blank, or inconsistent
comments.summary: Multiple recorded easements and required legal instruments lack proper Travis County document number callouts. Some references show blank placeholders instead of actual recorded instrument numbers, while others display inconsistent document references across sheets.
comments.crossDep: Public Works / ROW (verify license agreement status for retaining wall); Applicant legal counsel (ensure all agreements are recorded before filing)
comments.attn: Verify that IPM Plan, all easement agreements, and retaining wall license agreement are recorded with Travis County before filing final plans. Confirm correct document numbers from county records.

details.text: Greenbelt Access & Use Easement is referenced as 'Doc. 2010070731' on Sheet 9 but 'Doc. 2010040121' on Sheet 11. County records confirm 2010070731 as the correct instrument number. Sheet 11 must be corrected to match.

runComments.comment: Recorded easement document numbers are called out inconsistently across plan sheets. The Greenbelt Access & Use Easement is referenced as 'Doc. 2010070731' on Sheet 9 but 'Doc. 2010040121' on Sheet 11. The recorded instrument per county records is 2010070731. Sheet 11 contains an incorrect or conflicting document reference that must be corrected to ensure clear and accurate callout of the easement record number.

Travis County recorded document numbers are not clearly called out on the grading plan. Multiple easements are labeled with blank document number placeholders instead of actual recorded numbers: 'Wastewater Easement Doc#______', 'Sidewalk Easement Doc#______' (appears three times), and '10" Water Line Valve Easement Doc#______'. Actual document numbers must be provided.

details.text: Cover sheet (Sheet 1) includes a note for Integrated Pest Management Plan with blank space: 'For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No. ___________, Official Public Records, Travis County, Texas.' Actual recorded instrument number must be filled in.

runComments.comment: Required record reference shown as blank placeholder. The cover sheet includes a note for the Integrated Pest Management Plan with a blank space for the Travis County document number: 'For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No. ___________, Official Public Records, Travis County, Texas.' The document number must be filled in with the actual recorded instrument number rather than left blank.

Required record references are shown as placeholder blanks rather than actual recorded document numbers. Sheet 11 depicts multiple easements with blank callouts (Doc#______) that should contain Travis County recorded instrument numbers. Provide the actual recorded document numbers for all easements shown on the plan.

details.text: Site plan (Sheet 9) does not identify the existing concrete retaining wall in the ROW or include space for the license agreement recordation number. Code § 14-11-41 and LDE1 comments require this element and recorded document number to be shown.

runComments.comment: Site plan does not include a callout identifying the existing concrete retaining wall in the ROW requiring a license agreement, nor does it provide space for the license agreement recordation number. Per Code of Ordinances § 14-11-41 and LDE1 comments, the plan sheet must identify this element and include space for the recorded document number.

comments.headline: Site area acreage values inconsistent across sheets
comments.summary: Site acreage values are inconsistent across the cover sheet, site plan, and grading plan. Cover sheet shows 2.16 acres; Site Plan shows 94,192 sf (2.162 acres); COA GIS records indicate 2.111 acres. These discrepancies prevent accurate site area verification.
comments.crossDep: County Assessor / GIS (if significant discrepancy exists); Surveyor (if field verification needed)
comments.attn: Reconcile site area with current COA GIS records and confirm with registered surveyor. Land use consistency across supplementary documents could not be fully verified. Minor discrepancy between sheets (2.16 vs 2.162 acres) requires documentation of which is controlling.

details.text: Cover sheet (Sheet 1) shows 'Project Area: 2.16 Acres,' while Site Plan (Sheet 9) data table shows 'Site Area: 2.162 acres.' Although difference is minor (0.002 acres), values must be exactly consistent across all plan sheets and cover sheet.

runComments.comment: Acreage discrepancy exists between sheets. Cover sheet (Sheet 1) shows 'Project Area: 2.16 Acres,' while the site data table on Sheet 9 (Site Plan) shows 'Site Area: 2.162 acres.' Although the difference is minor (0.002 acres), the values are not exactly consistent across plan sheets.

Acreage values are inconsistent across sheets. Cover sheet states 2.16 acres; Site Plan (Sheet 9) shows 94,192 sf (2.162 acres). These values do not match. Acreage must be consistent across all site plan sheets and the cover sheet.

details.text: Site area shows further discrepancy: COA GIS measurement of parcel is 2.111 acres (91,944 sf), which differs from both Cover Sheet (2.16 acres) and Site Plan (94,192 sf / 2.162 acres). Accurate site area must be confirmed with current GIS or survey data.

runComments.comment: Site area calculations contain discrepancies. Cover sheet shows 2.16 acres; Site Plan (Sheet 9) shows 94,192 sf, which calculates to 2.162 acres. Additionally, facts.md notes COA GIS measures the parcel at 2.111 acres (91,944 sf). Site area accuracy cannot be verified due to these variations.

details.text: Proposed land use shown as 'Multi-Family Residential' with 39 townhome units is consistent on site plan sheets, but consistency with all supplementary application documents (building data table, parking table, engineering summary, Fire Department use table) could not be fully verified.

runComments.comment: Proposed land use shown as 'Multi-Family Residential' with 39 townhome units is consistent across site plan sheets reviewed; however, consistency with all required application documents (site data table, building data table, parking calculation table, building summary table, project application, TIA Determination Worksheet, Austin Fire Department intended use table, and engineering summary letter) cannot be verified without detailed review of all supplementary documents and their use designation tables.

All utility sheets must be re-sealed by designated engineer with consistent registration number and current dated signature. Verify version date of Austin Water sheet (Sheet 18) with utility department — run 1 could not confirm version status.
